title: Sealed Orchard
summary: Start: enter the system. The log opens Sealed Orchard and the helm marks Dead Dome. Do: Close on Dead Dome. The wardens patrol the quarantine. Lamp-moth graves and illegal culture vaults are the reason the gate still shoots. Finish: come inside Dead Dome's shell. The Choir writes standing. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close.
